newsitem.title: ITALY: SAI 1996 net profit slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: SAI 1996 net profit slightly higher.

text.p: Italy's insurance group SAI on Monday said its 1996 net profit rose to 94.1 billion lire against 92.1 billion lire in 1995, on premium income that increased 20 percent to 4.607 trillion lire.
A group statement from Italy's largest motor insurance company said the rise in premium income was helped by the acquisition of Nuova Maa in 1995.

Parent company results showed a fall in net profits to 84 billion lire from 90.3 billion lire and it proposed a dividend on ordinary shares unchanged at 200 lire/share and unchanged on on savings shares at 240 lire/share, said the statement.
